meta.name: objection-crusher
meta.description: Identify and neutralize buyer objections. Trigger on "why wouldn't someone buy", "objections", "hesitation", "conversion issues".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别并化解买家犹豫，提升转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析客户为什么不买并针对性说服
copy.tagline_en: Identify and neutralize buyer objections to boost conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze why customers hesitate and persuade them

howto.what: 当用户提到购买犹豫、反对意见或转化问题时，Claude 会列出常见的买家顾虑（如价格、时间、信任等），并用逻辑、证据和情感三种方式重新解释这些顾虑，最后给出反对意见和对应的回应。
howto.when: 当用户提到“为什么有人不买”、“反对意见”、“犹豫”或“转化问题”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出客户对这款软件常见的反对意见。
say.note: Claude 会列出价格、时间等常见顾虑。

say.text: 客户说太贵了，怎么回应？
say.note: Claude 会用逻辑、证据和情感方式重新解释。

howto.what_en: When the user mentions buyer hesitation, objections, or conversion issues, Claude lists common buyer concerns (e.g., price, time, trust) and reframes each using logic, proof, and emotion, then outputs objections and responses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "why wouldn't someone buy", "objections", "hesitation", or "conversion issues".

say_en.text: List common objections for this software.
say_en.note: Claude will list price, time, etc.

say_en.text: How to respond if a customer says it's too expensive?
say_en.note: Claude reframes using logic, proof, emotion.
